sourceSentences: Briar leaps to the target unit. If the target is an enemy, she deals physical damage, applies on-hit effects, triggers on-attack effects, stuns them for 0.85 seconds, and reduces their armor and magic resistance for 5 seconds.
Head Rush resets Briar's basic attack timer.
Head Rush can be cast on jungle plants, wards, and stealthed traps.
Briar breaks free from her pillory, causing her to become forced to basic attack the nearest enemy.
If she casts Head Rush on a minion or monster, she will shift her target priority to large monsters, minions or champions, then any other unit.
The frenzy ends early if there are no longer any nearby valid targets or Chilling Scream is cast.
Head Rush and Certain Death can be cast during the dash.
Blood Frenzy acquires targets regardless of if they are visible or not. This does not apply to stealthed targets.
Briar empowers her next basic attack within 5 seconds during Blood Frenzy to take a bite out of the target enemy
Snack Attack can only be used during Blood Frenzy; if the frenzy ends at any point, the empowered attack will be lost immediately.
Gaining Hematomania while Blood Frenzy is active will override the previous buff.
Chilling Scream's charge cannot be interrupted by crowd control.

If Chilling Scream was charged for its full duration, enemies hit are also knocked back 575 units. If they collide with terrain, they will rebound to take and become knocked up for 0.5 seconds and stunned for 1.5 seconds.
While the target is marked, they are revealed.
